description: Make a voice recording or TTS take game-ready: rumble high-passed, noise reduced against the measured floor, sibilance tamed, dialogue loudness (-18 LUFS) with a -1 dBTP ceiling, and a long take split into one file per phrase with a CSV cue sheet. Price: $0.10 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Audio tools: Make generated or recorded sounds game-ready: trim silence and match loudness (LUFS with a true-peak ceiling), seamless loops for music and ambience with loop points, and SFX variations.

audio.description: Audio file as base64 (wav, mp3, ogg, flac, m4a).

denoise.description: 0 gentle, 1 strong. Strong denoising can make a voice sound metallic.

minSilenceMs.description: A pause at least this long separates two phrases.

targetLufs.description: Dialogue loudness; -18 LUFS is a common game VO target.
